= Ike Starter Set

IkeFoundation starter set: the ledger-form content set for Ike.
        The source is an append-only version ledger (declared stamps, birth-FQN
        identity); building replays the ledger; the released artifacts are the
        standalone protobufs published under this aggregator coordinate —
        unreasoned-pb (stated-only) and reasoned-pb (classified, inferred results
        baked in) — with the changeset classifier reserved for genuine deltas
        (ike-issues#933; delta doctrine ike-issues#844).
        Generated by ike:starter-set-create; the SOP is the dev-knowledge-set-sop
        topic family in ike-lab-documents.
